subject: Kickoff: grasping benchmark revival (dql_grasping)
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the grasping-benchmark revival. Context: the manipulation roadmap needs a common yardstick before we commit Q3 OKRs, and our open-source grasping release is the right starting point — simulated grasping environments at several difficulty levels, with customizable DQL, MC, Supervised, Corr-MC, DDPG, and PCL learners, plus ready-made scripts for off-policy data collection and hyperparameter grid search.

What product gets out of it: an apples-to-apples comparison of the six algorithm families on our environments, so the roadmap picks a lane on evidence instead of vibes.

Milestones: environments and data-collection pipeline modernized by end of March, small-scale comparisons through May, the full grid-search sweep in late June, readout the first week of July.

Alina owns staffing and the compute reservation for the big sweep.

Ulla
